snippet.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on September 29, 2026! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-witcher-3-wild-hunt-remastered-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01
 
Become monster slayer-for-hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across the war-torn Northern Kingdoms. Can you find your adopted daughter, Ciri, before the spectral forces of the Wild Hunt take her incredible power for their own?
 
The modernized version includes a slew of upgrades and enhancements to visuals, performance, gameplay, and more. The stage is set for Songs of the Past—a brand-new expansion coming in 2027.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered will be available for free to owners of the Nintendo Switch version!

#NintendoDirect #TheWitcher3

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
